title: Recognize Intent folders and read their proof

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** At `d5f862c3ce66e132c7c03deeec1a56d6a6dc7319`, Project Intent’s maintained Chromium test caught a return to exclusive disclosure between two configured roots. The checked promise is independent folder disclosure in the Project Intent example of `SEED-420#recognize-intent-folders-and-read-proof`.

The mounted `intent-gherkin-groups.spec.ts` fixture presents `e2e_test/features` and `e2e_test/packaged/features`. The focused case opens both and first asserts that `e2e_test/features` is still expanded. In an isolated scratch worktree, I changed `IntentFileTree.tsx` so opening a configured root also closed open configured roots outside its ancestry. Fixtures and assertions stayed untouched.

The baseline passed one selected case. The faulted run reached disclosure of `e2e_test/packaged/features` and failed at the earlier root’s `aria-expanded` assertion, through `intent-scope-tree-page.ts:28` and `intent-gherkin-groups.spec.ts:107`. Expected `true`, received `false`. The rendered failure screenshot independently shows the earlier root closed with its file count, the packaged root open with `packaged.feature` visible, and the earlier file still shown in Purpose. I restored the original file, verified identical bytes and a clean scratch status at the same revision, reran the same case successfully, and removed the scratch checkout.

Command for all three runs was `env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-gherkin-groups.spec.ts --grep 'Project Intent discloses roots independently' --workers=1`. The fault patch, logs, and screenshot are retained under `/private/tmp/dough-intent-disclosure.g7ooVt/evidence`.

**Next proof action.** Retain the existing assertion. This observed Project Intent path needs no new or stronger check. No already-planned repair was identified for that path.

- **Test runtime.** Measured 32.35 seconds from the three Vitest duration summaries. Baseline 7.43 seconds, faulted 19.15 seconds, restored 5.77 seconds.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human intervention was observed, and human time was not separately measured.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. Agent effort was not metered separately from elapsed time and tool waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 118353 ms (measured), from 1795657230000 to 1795657348353 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: `d5f862c3ce66e132c7c03deeec1a56d6a6dc7319` — Caught. No follow-up.
